Dear Mr Hadley,

Thank you for getting back to me. We're glad you're open to a renewal, and we would like to renew for another year.

We'd like to keep the rent at the current £1,250 a month. We've been model tenants for 3 years and have always paid on time. We'd like to stay long term, and a steady, reliable tenancy is worth a lot to a landlord. Renewing with us also means you avoid any gap between tenants and the cost of finding someone new.

I'd rather not name a ceiling. Our aim is simply to renew at the current rent, and I hope we can agree on that. Our home is close to the school, so staying put matters a great deal to us, and we are not looking at other places.

If you're happy with £1,250, I'm glad to sign the renewal whenever suits you. Please let me know if you'd like to talk it through.

Kind regards,
[Your name]

Hi! Yes, the bike is still available.

I'm asking £450, but I'm open to offers. I don't want to give my lowest price away up front, so if you'd like to make me an offer, I'll consider it.

There has been a bit of interest. A couple of people have come to look, but nobody has bought it yet.

It's a 2021 Trek FX 3 Disc hybrid in size M. It was serviced in March and has new tyres from June. I should be upfront about two things. The gears can be a bit clunky when it's cold, and the saddle has a small tear.

You're welcome to come and see it and take it for a ride. Let me know when suits you.
